reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open on 2026-07-28 of the UUSD website, whitepaper PDF, GitHub repository README, /issuance, and /developers pages still finds no disclosure of backing assets, category weights, named counterparties, redemption rails, custody, or a reserve-assurance/attestation report. The whitepaper is a conceptual peer-to-peer AI-settlement essay with no reserve section. DefiLlama module 407 states mint/redeem text that UUSD is 'backed by a reserve of stablecoins including USDT and USDC', but no matching claim appears on any re-opened issuer primary; under the two-source rule that single aggregator line is not admitted as composition. The honest full-composition posture remains one 100% undisclosed-backing envelope with knownUnknownExposurePct 100.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: UUSD official disclosures and repository review; DefiLlama module 407 checked as non-corroborating aggregator claim
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The entire backing envelope is unclassified; no current composition, custody, redemption, or reserve-to-liability assurance evidence was found on issuer primaries.
